triggers.name: Verify email
triggers.description: Transactional confirm-your-address mail when a user starts signup or changes email.

triggers.name: Welcome after signup
triggers.description: Sent on account.created — the map after verify, not the confirmation click itself.

triggers.name: Password reset
triggers.description: Auth service calls this webhook when a user requests a password reset.

triggers.name: Magic link sign-in
triggers.description: Passwordless login from the app or desktop client. Short cooldown; do not suppress.

triggers.name: Contact us auto-reply
triggers.description: Thanks visitors after the marketing-site contact form submits.

triggers.name: Waitlist confirmation
triggers.description: Confirms product-list signup from the marketing site and upserts the contact onto Product Updates.

triggers.name: Demo request confirmation
triggers.description: Confirms a sales/demo form submit and restates what the team captured.

triggers.name: Support inbox auto-reply
triggers.description: Replies when mail arrives at support@relaybase.xyz so the thread is acknowledged.

triggers.name: Invoice receipt
triggers.description: Billing provider webhook after a successful charge — PDF link in the payload.

triggers.name: Team invite
triggers.description: Workspace invite from an existing member. Auth/app posts inviteUrl and workspace name.

triggers.name: Trial started
triggers.description: Billing webhook when a trial begins. Paused in this seed until the billing hook is wired.
